  {
    "n": 1,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Rabbit velocity components",
    "source": "Lecture 1",
    "statement": "A rabbit's motion is described by the equations $x(t) = -0.31t^2 + 7.2t + 28$ and $y(t) = 0.22t^2 - 9.1t + 30$. Find the rabbit's velocity at $t = 15\\text{ s}$."
  },
  {
    "n": 2,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Centripetal acceleration in fighter aircraft turn",
    "source": "Lecture 1",
    "statement": "An aircraft enters a horizontal circular turn with velocity $\\vec{v}_i = (400\\hat{\\imath} + 500\\hat{\\jmath})\\text{ m/s}$ and leaves the turn 24 seconds later with velocity $\\vec{v}_f = (-400\\hat{\\imath} - 500\\hat{\\jmath})\\text{ m/s}$. Assuming uniform circular motion, find the magnitude of the pilot's acceleration in $g$ units."
  },
  {
    "n": 3,
    "kind": "Example",
    "title": "Curvature radius of parabolic trajectory",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "statement": "A particle moves in the $xy$-plane with velocity $\\vec{v} = a\\hat{\\imath} + bx\\hat{\\jmath}$, starting from the origin $x = y = 0$ at $t = 0$. Find the equation of the particle's trajectory $y(x)$ and the curvature radius of the trajectory as a function of $x$."
  },
  {
    "n": 4,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Velocity graph from piecewise acceleration",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "statement": "An object moves with piecewise constant acceleration: $0\\text{ m/s}^2$ for $t \\in [0, 2]\\text{ s}$, $1\\text{ m/s}^2$ for $t \\in [2, 4]\\text{ s}$, $2\\text{ m/s}^2$ for $t \\in [4, 6]\\text{ s}$, and $-3\\text{ m/s}^2$ for $t \\in [6, 8]\\text{ s}$. Plot the velocity of the object as a function of time."
  },
  {
    "n": 5,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Airplane airspeed under eastward wind",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "statement": "A transcontinental flight of $4950\\text{ km}$ is scheduled to take 1 hour longer westward than eastward due to a constant wind blowing due east at speed $v_0 = 100\\text{ km/h}$. Assuming the airplane flies with constant airspeed throughout, find its airspeed $v$."
  },
  {
    "n": 6,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Initial speed of accelerating car",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "statement": "A vehicle moving with constant acceleration covers a distance of $60\\text{ m}$ between two points in $6\\text{ s}$. If its speed passing the second point is $15.0\\text{ m/s}$, find its speed $v_0$ at the first point."
  },
  {
    "n": 7,
    "kind": "Task",
    "title": "Center coordinates of circular path",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "statement": "A particle moves along a circular path in a horizontal $xy$-plane at constant speed. At $t_1 = 4\\text{ s}$, it is at point $(5\\text{ m}, 6\\text{ m})$ with velocity $3\\hat{\\jmath}\\text{ m/s}$ and acceleration in the positive $x$ direction, and at $t_2 = 10\\text{ s}$, it has velocity $-3\\hat{\\imath}\\text{ m/s}$ and acceleration in the positive $y$ direction. Find the coordinates of the center of the circular path if $t_2 - t_1$ is less than one period."
  }
]
